name: Stepped Content – guide readers through content one step at a time
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn overwhelming walls of text into engaging, guided steps your readers actually finish.

Stepped Content | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why Stepped Content?

Long pages lose readers. Stepped Content is a powerful Gutenberg plugin that transforms long content into engaging, guided steps. Instead of overwhelming visitors with large blocks of text, you break information into simple, digestible sections – boosting readability and user engagement.

Whether you’re creating tutorials, onboarding flows, guides, lessons, courses, or feature walkthroughs, Stepped Content gives you clean navigation, customizable layouts, and flexible design controls – all from the block editor, no coding required.

Demos

Free Features

  • Reading Time Indicator: Show the remaining duration needed to finish reading the content.
  • Custom Step Height: Set a custom height for the step content.
  • Navbar Customization: Customize the navbar with a custom title and colors.
  • Sidebar Colors: Apply different colors to the sidebar menu.
  • Per-Step Styling: Change the text color and background for each step.
  • Step Titles: Show or hide the step title, or set a custom title instead of the default.
  • Button Colors: Set custom colors for the Back, Next, and Done buttons.

Pro Version – Unlock Premium Power

Stepped Content Pro adds layout enhancements and deeper content control for advanced users.

Pro features include:

  • Navigation Bar Toggle: Show or hide the top navigation bar.
  • Sidebar Themes: Change the sidebar theme for better appearance.
  • Custom Back Button: Use an icon, the previous step title, or custom text.
  • Custom Next Button: Use an icon, the next step title, or custom text.
  • Custom Done Button: Set custom text for the Done button.
  • Done Button Target: Choose whether the Done button link opens in a new or current tab.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Stepped Content plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Stepped Content block from the “Widgets” block category.
  3. Add your steps and adjust settings from the right-side settings sidebar.
  4. Publish and enjoy!

Live Demo | Upgrade to Pro

Use Cases

  • Tutorials & How-Tos: Walk readers through processes one step at a time.
  • Onboarding Flows: Guide new users or customers through setup.
  • Documentation: Organize product docs into clear, navigable sections.
  • Lessons & Courses: Deliver learning material in digestible steps.
  • Feature Walkthroughs: Present product features as a guided tour.

User Feedback

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect for my site

❛❛I needed some specialized version of the stepped content plugin and contacted support. Within a week they added the features I needed to their premium version, which was more than I expected. It works perfectly.❜❜

  • External Services: Communicates with api.bplugins.com (activation events) and wp.freemius.com (opt-in processing) only after user opt-in. See bPlugins Privacy Policy and Freemius Privacy Policy.

  • Purpose: Provides opt-in usage tracking and analytics to help improve the plugin.

bpl-tools

  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Shared utility library providing admin dashboard components and common Gutenberg editor controls.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Stepped Content”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Stepped Content block to any post or page from the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Stepped Content plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the plugin .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
What is Stepped Content?

Stepped Content is a Gutenberg plugin that breaks long content into interactive steps or tabs, improving clarity and user engagement.

Do I need coding skills to use it?

No. All customization options are available directly in the Gutenberg editor with simple visual controls.

Can I customize the design?

Yes. You can customize colors, backgrounds, titles, buttons, themes, and step layouts with ease.

Can I customize the Back, Next, and Done buttons?

Yes. The free version lets you set custom colors for all three buttons. The Pro version adds icons, step-title labels, and fully custom text.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Stepped Content is compatible with all modern, well-coded WordPress themes.

Is there a free version?

Yes. Many core features are available for free, with additional advanced options unlocked in Pro.

Can I hide step titles?

Absolutely. You can show, hide, or replace step titles with custom text.

Does it affect website speed?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring fast loading and smooth transitions.

Is the reading duration accurate?

Reading time is estimated using industry-standard methods based on average reading speed.

Can I control the Done button behavior?

Yes. You can choose whether the Done button opens a link in a new tab or the current tab.

Can I use it for tutorials or onboarding?

Yes! It’s perfect for tutorials, onboarding flows, documentation, lessons, courses, and multi-step guides.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
